title: expression.evaluate
description: Evaluate a metric expression against one event on one of three surfaces (mode): rails = event ingestion by the billing API (value stored into properties[field_name]); ep = the events-processor (expression result stored as text); preview = the expression test endpoint POST /api/v1/billable_metrics/evaluate_expression. See BE-EX for the language and the per-surface input conversions.

expression.description: Expression text. rails: non-blank (a blank metric expression means "no expression" at ingestion, BE-EX-7; it is graded through events.validate, not by this op). preview: null, empty or blank is allowed and rejected by the endpoint. ep: any text (a blank one fails like any unparsable expression).

event.x-kit-absent: mode ep with event_json, or mode preview without an event
event.description: rails: the submitted event {code, timestamp?, properties?} as sent to POST /api/v1/events (timestamp as in BE-EV; absent = now). preview: the `event` member sent to the preview endpoint {code?, timestamp?, properties?}. ep: the event object handed to the engine, equivalent to event_json holding its JSON text: the member checks of BE-EX-40 apply alike. Prefer event_json when a number literal's digits or scale matter, since an object carries numbers, not their text.

event_json.description: ep only: exact JSON text of the event object handed to the engine: {"code":<string>,"timestamp":<number>,"properties":{...}} plus members the engine ignores. The engine reads every number literal of this text exactly (significand and scale as written, BE-EX-40); a missing or null `properties`, a missing or non-string `code` or a missing or null `timestamp` fails the evaluation. Which literal the processor hands over is its own profile-dependent rule (events-processor-spec EP-C5, RBD-14), graded by the ep vectors.

now.description: Wall clock (whole seconds) for a missing timestamp (rails, preview).

value.description: The result: a canonical decimal for a number (compared numerically), the text for a string.

type.description: rails and preview: the result kind (not observable in mode ep).

text.description: Exact text of the result where it lands: rails = the text stored in properties[field_name]; ep = the text the engine returns (stored by the processor); preview = the `value` string of the response body. Compared as text.
